title: TestRunner agent remote code execution
fix: Upgrade TestRunner agent to 4.2.1 or remove the agent

title: VPN gateway path traversal exposes session tokens
fix: Apply vendor firmware 9.4.7; then invalidate all VPN sessions and rotate admin credentials

title: RDP exposed to the internet without MFA
fix: Remove the public RDP rule; allow RDP only through the VPN with MFA

title: Database server privilege escalation by authenticated user
Browser engine remote code execution (malicious web page)
fix: Push browser 131.0.2 through endpoint management; force restart within 24h

title: SMBv1 protocol enabled
fix: Disable SMBv1 (Set-SmbServerConfiguration -EnableSMB1Protocol $false) after checking legacy clients

title: Printer web admin uses default credentials
fix: Set a unique admin password and store it in the password vault

title: TLS 1.0 enabled
fix: Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1 on the load balancer

title: TestRunner web console information disclosure
fix: Upgrade TestRunner agent to 4.2.1 or remove the agent
